subject.title: [Bug] MiniMax Token Plan (Max) broken in sub-agents after v5.22 bootstrap change

question: Should OpenClaw keep sub-agent bootstrap limited to AGENTS.md and TOOLS.md while fixing only proven MiniMax provider/runtime bugs, or should Token Plan skill bundles be inherited by sub-agents as a supported behavior?
rationale: The current code separates skill prompt loading from bootstrap files, and the documented child-context boundary is intentional; changing it for Token Plan would affect sub-agent context/security policy rather than being a narrow endpoint bug fix.

options.title: Keep boundary, prove provider bug
options.body: Maintain the current sub-agent bootstrap contract and require live MiniMax Token Plan proof before changing provider endpoint/auth behavior.

options.title: Support Token Plan inheritance
options.body: Explicitly make Token Plan skill-bundle inheritance a supported sub-agent behavior, with scoped docs, tests, and security review.

options.title: Move Token Plan bundle out of core
options.body: Treat the office/media Token Plan skill bundle as a ClawHub or plugin-owned package and only extend core if a missing API seam is proven.

recommendation.title: Keep boundary, prove provider bug
recommendation.body: Maintain the current sub-agent bootstrap contract and require live MiniMax Token Plan proof before changing provider endpoint/auth behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Eva authored the bootstrap-boundary change that this issue asks maintainers to revisit.
